stories.title: Mahmood scraps settlement plans for migrant care workers
stories.summary: The home secretary will lay out a revised proposal for changing when migrants can claim permanent residency later. Home Secretary Shabana Mahmood will announce her final decision on changes to immigration rules on Monday. Mahmood proposed extending the wait for permanent settlement from the current five years to 10, with some lower-paid migrants facing a 15-year wait, in response to a period of high net migration. But she faced criticism for proposing to apply the changes to migrant workers already in the UK, with Housing Secretary Angela Rayner saying this would "change the goalposts" .

stories.title: Wage protests force hundreds of Bangladesh garment factories to close
stories.summary: These factories, which manufacture for brands like H&M and Uniqlo, rely on millions of lowly paid workers. Hundreds of garment factories in Bangladesh have been forced to closed after days-long protests by workers demanding higher wages. On Sunday, protests in the capital Dhaka turned violent with protesters blocking roads, vandalising factories and setting vehicles on fire. They also clashed with police, who fired tear gas to disperse them. Police later said that dozens of protesters had been arrested. Workers are demanding a minimum monthly wage of 30,000 taka ($242; £180), more than double the current standard, citing rising costs of living.

The Lions actually controlled most of the game, too, and took a 16-point lead just after the break before hanging on to secure the 68-64 upset win. The Sooners closed as a 28.5-point favorite.
